overlay.assistantText: <summary>Specification for a minimal task tracker with types, store, format modules, and tests using Bun + TypeScript</summary><scope>Create four TypeScript files in the src directory: types.ts (Task interface and TaskFilter type), store.ts (TaskStore class with in-memory Map), format.ts (task formatting functions), and store.test.ts (at least 6 test cases using bun:test)</scope><content>ScopeThis task involves creating a minimal task tracker module system with four files:src/types.ts - Shared type definitionssrc/store.ts - In-memory task storage with CRUD operationssrc/format.ts - Task display formatting utilitiessrc/store.test.ts - Unit tests for the store moduleRequirementsFunctional RequirementsTypes Module (src/types.ts)Export a Task interface with: id (string), title (string), completed (boolean)Export a TaskFilter type for filtering tasks by completion status: { completed?: boolean }Store Module (src/store.ts)Export a TaskStore class backed by an in-memory Map<string, Task>Implement add(title: string): Task - creates a new task with unique ID, returns the taskImplement toggle(id: string): Task | undefined - toggles completed status, returns updated task or undefinedImplement remove(id: string): boolean - removes task, returns true if foundImplement list(filter?: TaskFilter): Task[] - returns filtered list of tasksFormat Module (src/format.ts)Export formatTask(task: Task): string - returns "[x] title" if completed, "[ ] title" if notExport formatTaskList(tasks: Task[]): string - returns numbered list with each task formattedTest Module (src/store.test.ts)Use bun:test framework (import { test, expect } from "bun:test")At least 6 test cases covering:add: creates task with correct propertiestoggle: flips completed statusremove: deletes task and returns correct booleanlist with no filter: returns all taskslist with completed: true filterlist with completed: false filterNon-Functional RequirementsAll files must use ES module syntax (import/export)Strict TypeScript mode must be satisfiedCode must include clear comments explaining intent and non-obvious logicModules should be cohesive and loosely coupledConstraintsOnly create or modify the four specified files: src/types.ts, src/store.ts, src/format.ts, src/store.test.tsDo not add package.json, tsconfig.json, README files, or any other filesBun runtime and bun:test are already availableMust follow project preferences: code comments, cohesive design, no workaroundsAcceptance CriteriaAll four files exist in the src directory with correct exportssrc/types.ts exports Task interface and TaskFilter type with correct structuresrc/store.ts exports TaskStore class with all four methods working correctlysrc/format.ts exports both formatting functions with correct output formatsrc/store.test.ts contains at least 6 test cases that all pass when run with bun testTypeScript compilation succeeds with strict mode enabledCode includes appropriate comments explaining key logic</content><spec_items>title: Create src/types.ts with Task interface and TaskFilter typedescription: Create src/types.ts exporting Task interface (id: string, title: string, completed: boolean) and TaskFilter type ({ completed?: boolean }) with appropriate JSDoc commentscheck_selector: buildpriority: blockingtitle: Create src/store.ts with TaskStore classdescription: Create src/store.ts exporting TaskStore class with in-memory Map storage, implementing add(title), toggle(id), remove(id), and list(filter?) methods with proper error handling and commentscheck_selector: buildpriority: blockingtitle: Create src/format.ts with formatting functionsdescription: Create src/format.ts exporting formatTask(task) returning "[x] title" or "[ ] title" and formatTaskList(tasks) returning numbered list, with comments explaining format conventionscheck_selector: buildpriority: blockingtitle: Create src/store.test.ts with 6+ test casesdescription: Create src/store.test.ts using bun:test with at least 6 tests: add creates correct task, toggle flips status, remove returns correct boolean, list returns all tasks, list filters by completed:true, list filters by completed:falsecheck_selector: testpriority: blockingtitle: Verify TypeScript compilation with strict modedescription: Ensure all files compile successfully with the existing tsconfig.json strict settings, no type errorscheck_selector: buildpriority: blockingtitle: Verify all tests pass with bun testdescription: Run bun test src/store.test.ts and verify all 6+ test cases passcheck_selector: testpriority: blocking</spec_items><out_of_scope>Adding package.json, tsconfig.json, or any configuration filesCreating README files (per explicit task constraint, overrides preference)Adding CLI interface or UI componentsPersistence beyond in-memory storageAdditional features like due dates, priorities, or categories</out_of_scope><assumptions>Q: Should the Task ID be generated using crypto.randomUUID() or a simple counter?A: We assume crypto.randomUUID() for production-quality unique IDs, as Bun supports this nativelyQ: Should toggle() throw an error if task not found or return undefined?A: We assume return undefined for consistency with remove() returning boolean, allowing caller to handle missing tasks gracefullyQ: Should list() preserve insertion order?A: We assume yes, as Map iteration order follows insertion order in JavaScript</assumptions><evidence>package.json: Shows "type": "module" for ES modulestsconfig.json: Shows ES2022 target, strict mode handling issues in toggle/removeMitigation: Use proper return types (Task | undefined, boolean) and handle edge cases explicitlyRisk: Test file imports may fail if module resolution is misconfiguredMitigation: Use relative imports with .ts extension for Bun compatibility</risks>
